user_statement: MP3D合法取得，有授权文件，批准预算，如果没有空闲gpu可以释放后面占位的程序释放gpu，并在用完之后占用回去
scope: Independent Habitat runtime setup and bounded renderer smoke only
gpu_guardrails: Use a free GPU first; only if none is free inspect higher-index cards for verified owner placeholders
Record device UUID/ordinal, PID/start time, ownership, exact command and project-local script, tmux pane/session and original settings before any release
Verify a restorable launch method before stopping a placeholder; utilization or memory occupancy alone does not identify a placeholder
Recheck PID identity immediately before action; no broad pkill, process-group kill or tmux server/session termination
Stopping execution with SIGSTOP does not generally release GPU memory; verify actual resource release and do not use a blind STOP/CONT recipe
Restore the recorded placeholder configuration on the original device after own GPU context is closed, on success, failure or interruption
Do not create a placeholder on an originally idle card or duplicate one already restored; report if an unrelated task now prevents safe restoration
Record restoration evidence; restoration failure leaves GPU cleanup incomplete and must be reported
